mono.purpose: Machine output: logs, identifiers, key prefixes, metrics.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers and dialogs only; dark theme uses #00000099.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn2 { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn2:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); background: var(--status-danger-tint); color: var(--status-danger); border: 1px solid var(--status-danger-border); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, hint or error below.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field-label { font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 10.5px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px var(--font-sans); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-subtle); } .ds-input:hover, .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--text); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-subtle); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 220px; padding: 10px; background: var(--surface); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav-item { height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Inline Notice
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--status-success-border); background: var(--status-success-tint); color: var(--status-success); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); }

narrative.overview: FerroDock is a clean workbench: every tool hangs where it belongs, nothing is there for show, and attention goes to the work on the bench. Every surface is a solid neutral grey; colour appears only when it carries meaning. Depth comes from tonal layering and 1px opaque lines rather than shadows. Components feel precise and calm.
keyCharacteristics: Solid, opaque neutral surfaces only (R = G = B); semantic status colours are the sole hues.
WCAG AA floor for every text, AAA for primary and secondary text.
Poppins for interface text, JetBrains Mono for machine output; tonal layering instead of shadows; light, dark and system themes with identical hierarchy.

rules.name: The Signal Only Rule
rules.body: A hue appears only when it reports state. If removing the colour would lose no information, the colour must not be there.

rules.name: The Opaque Fill Rule
rules.body: Fills never use alpha. A soft background is a pre-blended opaque token, so it never shifts with what sits beneath it.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for text a machine produced or a person must copy exactly. It is never used as decoration to look technical.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow. If an element seems to need one, step its surface tone instead.

dos: Do take every colour from tokens; light and dark values ship together.
Do keep primary and secondary text at AAA and everything else at AA or better.
Do animate only transform, opacity and clip-path, 100-350ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and honour reduced motion.
Do show skeletons shaped like the final content instead of spinners, and use Phosphor icons in one weight.
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, glows, blobs or purple-blue accent colour.
Don't use alpha-transparent fills or pure #000 and #fff.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings, section numbers or decorative status dots.
Don't nest cards or lay out three identical feature cards.
Don't run infinite decorative animation; the only loop is a building indicator that stops when hidden.
